pr_title: Add RouteHandlerContext as parameter to IRouteHandlerFilter.InvokeAsync
pr_comments: I'm not a huge fan of this. It means that if we ever want to support a lifetime other than instantiate per request, then there's no way to cache the data from this context. That's why I prefer the constructor approach.

> Does any of this new functionality have docs? And if not have we applied the doc label to the issues/prs?

Docs issue is https://github.com/dotnet/AspNetCore.Docs/issues/25483.

Will do a follow-up to update runtime with nicer APIs for registering optional arguments for `ActivatorUtilities` but merging this for now.
Left a comment, I really don’t like this exception but if we have a follow up issue it’s fine. We avoid first chance exceptions like this in the overall stack
